data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3104, commit d2d7438722c (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, no advisories). Cross-process tests run a child interpreter under PYTHONHASHSEED 1 and 2 and require the same non-empty ordered spot-check keys; a second test swaps the bucket for hash() inside the child and requires the seeds to disagree. Mutation check: with the real renderer changed to hash(), the cross-process test failed while the old in-process test still passed. In-process test renamed and its docstring corrected. The first make verify caught my own raw os.environ use (policy scan), fixed with the subprocess_env helper.
